title: M. Karunanidhi v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: M. Karunanidhi v. Union of India, (1979) 3 SCC 431
content.holding: 5-judge Bench formulated the three definitive tests of repugnancy: direct conflict, occupied field, and identical offences with divergent penalties; established presumption of compatibility.
content.relevance: Locus classicus on tests of repugnancy under Article 254.

evidence.note: Supreme Court of India (1979) 3 SCC 431; 1979 INSC 55; 1979 (3) SCR 254; Article 254 constitutional rules on repugnancy.
